entries.wording: Shipment information received
entries.note: The order's data arriving, its first row, seconds before the delivery partner's pre-advice.

entries.wording: Shipping Label Created
entries.note: The label made for the order, hours before the warehouse's first scan.

entries.wording: Order information has been transmitted to DPD.
entries.note: The order's data handed to DPD, the delivery partner, as the first row, days before the warehouse's first scan.

entries.wording: Your package is being prepared by the sender and will be handed over to us soon
entries.note: The order's data, its first row, hours before the warehouse's first scan: the sender still has the parcel.

entries.wording: 发件人已创建标签，但是 UPS 尚未收到包裹。
entries.note: UPS's label row, which the tracker copies in Chinese on a line UPS delivers, as JRT's does: the label exists and UPS does not have the parcel yet.

entries.wording: Label Created, Shipper created a label, UPS has not received the package yet.
entries.note: The same label row of UPS's in UPS's English.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at facility
entries.note: The first scan in Lingdong's hands, at its Shenzhen warehouse.

entries.wording: Shipment departed from facility

entries.note: A row the tracker shows with a full stop alone, after the warehouse's departure: it names nothing, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: Customs export clearance completed
entries.note: Export clearance in China, the day after the warehouse's departure and before the flight.

entries.wording: Package handed over to airline
entries.note: The hand-over to the airline, an hour after the export clearance.

entries.wording: 预计…航班/Flight scheduled for …
entries.note: The flight booked for the parcel, after it leaves the warehouse; the flight's day, month.day and in English, is read as an ellipsis. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 预计…航班/Scheduled flight on …
entries.note: The same booked flight in another English, its day read as an ellipsis. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 送往航司途中【On the way to the airline company】
entries.note: On its way to the airline after leaving the warehouse.

entries.wording: Expected flight on …
entries.note: The same booked flight in a third English, its month abbreviated, "Nov. 19th", read as an ellipsis. Whatever Chinese half comes before it, the English half marks the row. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 预计…号航班【Expect flight ….】
entries.note: The flight booked for the parcel; the flight's day of the month, in Chinese and in English, is read as an ellipsis. A forecast, not a movement, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: 航班已起飞【The flight has taken off.】
entries.note: The booked flight has left.

entries.wording: It is expected to arrive at the local time on the …
entries.note: The flight's expected landing after it took off, the day of the month read as an ellipsis, as "17th". A forecast, not a movement: the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.

entries.wording: There is a delay in the flight schedule. It is expected to arrive at the local time on the …
entries.note: The same forecast after a delay to the flight's schedule.

entries.wording: 航班抵达【Flight arrival】
entries.note: The flight has landed.

entries.wording: Departed from Port of Origin
entries.note: The flight leaving its airport of origin, in English alone, after the forwarder's own departure rows.

entries.wording: Arrived at … Airport
entries.note: The flight's arrival at the airport the row names, which the map reads as an ellipsis, the morning after the departure from the port of origin.

entries.wording: Arrived at customs clearance warehouse
entries.note: At the warehouse where the destination's customs clear the cargo, a day after the flight's arrival and before the release.

entries.wording: Arrived at sorting center
entries.note: The last-mile courier's sorting centre in the destination country, after the hand-off to it.

entries.wording: Customs clearance completed
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs, the day after the flight's arrival there.

entries.wording: In transit to last mile operator
entries.note: On its way to the delivering partner, hours after the customs release and a day before the hand-over to it.

entries.wording: Delivery to last mile operator
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivering partner, hours after the customs release.

entries.wording: SHIPMENT RECEIVED IN DEPOT
entries.note: The delivering partner's depot taking the parcel in, hours after the hand-over, before its round.

entries.wording: 航班已启运/Package in transit to destination country
entries.note: The booked flight has left.

entries.wording: 航班已落地，拆板中/Package arrived at destination country
entries.note: The flight has landed and its pallets are being broken down.

entries.wording: 已完成国内报关手续【Domestic customs clearance procedures have been completed.】
entries.note: Cleared after the landing, before the delivery.

entries.wording: 货物已清关完成/Import customs clearance complete
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs, the day after the landing.

entries.wording: 拆板作业中，等待取货通知【Under destuffing, waiting for pickup instructions.】
entries.note: The flight's pallets are broken down after the landing while the cargo waits to be collected for clearance: not a collection by the recipient.

entries.wording: 货物在清关【Customs clearance in progress】
entries.note: In the destination's customs, after the landing.

entries.wording: 货物已完成清关【The goods have completed customs clearance】
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs, hours after its clearance began.

entries.wording: 货物已交服务商【The shipment has been transferred to the logistics partner.】
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivery partner after the import release.

entries.wording: Customs import clearance completed, awaiting pickup by local carrier
entries.note: Released by the destination's customs while the cargo waits for the delivering partner to collect it: the recipient has nothing to collect.

entries.wording: 包裹交接给本地物流商处理/Received by local delivery company
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivery partner after the import release, a day before the partner's hub scan.

entries.wording: Package picked up by last-mile carrier
entries.note: The delivering partner collecting the parcel, a day after the import release.

entries.wording: Arrived at GOFO Regional Hub
entries.note: GOFO, the delivery partner in the United States, taking the parcel in at its regional hub.

entries.wording: First parcel scan along Poste Italiane’s logistic network
entries.note: Poste Italiane's first scan as the delivery partner, a day after the hand-over to it, relayed in capitals: the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: In transit along Poste Italiane’s logistic network
entries.note: Poste Italiane moving the parcel towards the office that delivers it.

entries.wording: In transito, la spedizione è in transito
entries.note: Poste Italiane's scan on the way to the delivering office, relayed with its headline.

entries.wording: In transito
entries.note: The same scan's headline alone, a second row at the same time.

entries.wording: In consegna
entries.note: Poste Italiane's courier is out with the parcel, hours before its delivery.

entries.wording: Consegnata, la spedizione è stata consegnata
entries.note: Poste Italiane delivered the parcel, the last row of the record.

entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The platform writes this row itself for an order without scans, on its creation time.

entries.wording: OUT FOR DELIVERY
entries.note: The delivering partner's round, after its depot took the parcel in.

entries.wording: DELIVERED
entries.note: The delivering partner's delivery, hours after its round, the last row of the record.
